The '''bog spitter''' was a native [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]]. The bog spitters were a nuisance to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] patrols along with the [[Jagomiri swamp stalker]]s when the [[Ardan resistance]] set up a [[Resolute Base|base]] on Jagomir.<ref name="OAA1" />
